styles.label: Culture
styles.blurb: Museums, the river skyline and the old town.

styles.label: History
styles.blurb: Cathedral, Römer and the Paulskirche story.

styles.label: Food
styles.blurb: Apfelwein taverns, sausages and market halls.

stays.why: Walk to the Römer, cathedral and river in minutes. Quiet at night, few budget rooms.
Cheapest central beds and the main station on your doorstep. Lively and gritty at night.
South-bank Apfelwein taverns and river walks; 10–15 minutes into the centre on foot or tram.
Leafy, calm and close to the trade-fair halls and Palmengarten. Good for business trips.

food: Try Frankfurter Grüne Soße (green herb sauce with eggs and potatoes) and Frankfurter sausages.
Drink Apfelwein (apple wine) in a Sachsenhausen tavern; ask for it 'sauer' with sparkling water.
Kleinmarkthalle market hall: graze on sausages, cheese and coffee, roughly €5–15 per snack.
Bakeries and kiosks sell pretzels and sandwiches for about €3–6; good for a quick lunch.
Book dinner on Friday and Saturday nights; popular taverns fill up. Check prices on the menu first.
more_time: Swap a city afternoon for a Rhine Valley day: trains run south to Rüdesheim and the river villages; check times on the day.
Add a stop at the Städel Museum for old masters and modern art; allow 2–3 hours.
Cross to Sachsenhausen for a slow riverside walk and an Apfelwein dinner instead of a second museum.

recommend.why: Two nights cover the museums, old town and a Sachsenhausen Apfelwein evening without rushing.

month_notes: Coldest month: highs near 5°C, lows around 0°C, and about 14 rain days. Pack a warm coat.
Still cold, highs near 8°C, with fewer rainy days (about 11).
Mild but wet: highs near 11°C and about 13 rain days. Bring an umbrella.
Spring warms to highs near 15°C; about 11 rain days.
Pleasant: highs near 20°C, lows around 10°C. Good walking weather.
Warm start to summer: highs near 25°C and about 11 rain days.
Warmest month: highs near 26°C, lows around 16°C, about 10 rain days.
Similar to July: highs near 26°C. Book hotels early for trade-fair weeks.
Cooling down: highs near 21°C and the driest month (about 9 rain days).
Autumn: highs near 16°C, lows around 8°C, about 11 rain days.
Grey and wet: highs near 9°C and about 14 rain days.
Cold and wet: highs near 6°C, lows around 1°C, about 14 rain days. Expect Christmas markets.

climate_guide.summary: Temperate climate with warm summers and cold, grey winters. Rain is spread across the year, so pack layers and an umbrella any month.

items.title: Best time: May to September
items.text: Highs of 20–26°C and long evenings. Ideal for the riverbank, old town and beer gardens.

items.title: Winter is cold (December to February)
items.text: Highs of 5–8°C and lows near 0–1°C. Wear a warm coat, hat and gloves.

items.title: Rain all year
items.text: About 9–14 rain days every month. November, December and January are the wettest.

items.title: Carry an umbrella
items.text: Showers are common and can be sudden. A light rain jacket beats an umbrella in wind.

items.title: September is the driest
items.text: About 9 rain days and highs near 21°C. A comfortable month for walking.

items.title: What to pack
items.text: Layers, a waterproof jacket and comfortable shoes. Add a warm coat and gloves for November to March.

transit.best: Walk the centre; use U-Bahn and trams for longer hops, and ride apps at night.

modes.text: U-Bahn and S-Bahn run on one RMV network. Buy a ticket before boarding. Single ticket in the centre is €3.80; a day ticket is €7.75.
Trams and buses use the same RMV tickets. Buy before boarding.
Uber, Bolt and Free Now all work in the city. Handy late at night.
Easy to reach by car but parking is hard. Use park-and-ride during trade fairs.
The centre is walkable. Bikes and e-scooters are widely available.
S-Bahn lines S8/S9 link the airport and suburbs. They are often delayed, so allow buffer time.
